title: PR #120: governance: propose ARR lifecycle, schema, and registry
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose

Propose a governed Architecture Requirement Request (ARR) lifecycle for software and architecture requirements in `a-townchain-ecosystem`.

## Changes

- `docs/governance/ARR-LIFECYCLE-001.md`: lifecycle, authority boundaries, exact-SHA evidence rules, and rollout acceptance checklist.
- `docs/governance/schemas/arr-record.schema.json`: machine-readable ARR record schema.
- `docs/governance/arr-registry.json`: proposed registry with ARR-0001 and explicit open residuals.

## Separation of duties

- Governance owns normative policy and authorized acceptance.
- atc-engineering owns technical validators and CI/evidence enforcement.
- Ecosystem records architecture, SSOT references, integration/compliance mapping, and residuals.
- Canonical implementation repositories retain implementation source and component-level contracts.

## Explicit limitations

- Draft proposal only; not merged or approved.
- No validator, tests, CI workflow, or branch-protection changes are included in this PR.
- The registry has not yet been reconciled against ATC-STD-REGISTRY-001 and other existing SSOT registries.
- ARR-0001 remains SPECIFIED; governance approval and exact-SHA enforcement are residuals.
- No merge automation, gate weakening, or production-readiness claim.

## Acceptance gates before promotion

1. Independent Governance and Engineering review.
2. Reconcile registry ownership with the currently approved registry standard.
3. Add positive/negative schema tests and a fail-closed validator.
4. Bind CI execution and evidence to the exact 40-character source SHA.
5. Verify required checks and migrate existing requirements or record explicit residuals.

Do not merge until review and required evidence are complete.
